newsitem.title: USA: Elsag Bailey to take AspenTech software.
newsitem.headline: Elsag Bailey to take AspenTech software.

text.p: Elsag Bailey Process Automation said Thursday it will integrate software made by Aspen Technology Inc into a series of products designed to automate some stages of manufacturing.
Elsag Bailey, which makes things like instruments that report measurements from the plant floor, said it will integrate the software into its Performer Series under an agreement signed with Aspen.

It said it will also coordinate its sales and marketing campaigns with those of Aspen, which makes software that helps process manufacturers in sectors like chemicals and pulp and paper to operate more efficiently.
Based in the Netherlands, Elsag Bailey is controlled by Italian state group Finmeccanica SpA.
Aspen's offices are located in Cambridge, Mass.
